title: agent-egress-bench Result
description: A single result line from a benchmark runner (JSONL output). One result per case, recording the expected verdict, actual verdict, score, and tool-specific evidence. Note: cross-field constraints (e.g. score consistency with actual_verdict) are enforced by the Go validator, not this schema.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 4 for active scoring; prior schemas are frozen historical formats.

case_id.description: The case ID from the case file.

tool.description: Tool name from the tool profile.

tool_version.description: Tool version from the tool profile.

expected_verdict.description: Expected verdict from the case file.

actual_verdict.description: Verdict observed by the runner. unreachable means unreachable by this adapter and configuration, never unsupported by product. error means a declared route failed during startup, fixture setup, delivery, correlation, or observation.

score.description: pass if the observed behavior satisfies the case scoring contract, fail if not, error if runner/tool failure.

evidence.description: Tool-specific evidence supporting the verdict. Freeform structure.
